item.description:
Release v5.9.0

Changes since v5.8.4

  • feat: 更新 App Store 推广页面和相关插件
  • feat: 更新 App Store 推广页面和 UI 组件
  • feat(AppStorePromo): expand designer plugin tools and document model
  • feat(AppStorePromoDesignerPlugin): support per-project storage alongside app storage
  • feat(BookletMakerPlugin): inject dynamic title into centre title toolbar
  • feat(DiskManager): add agent tools for disk management
  • feat(GoalTaskPlugin): hide toolbar button when no goals exist
  • feat(HTTPExchangeStore): add nonisolated background write path
  • feat(ListV2View): render independent streaming row with stable ID
  • feat(ListV2ViewModel): subscribe to streaming store with frame gate
  • feat(ListV3View): mirror V2 streaming row support + add explicit .id()
  • feat(MessageStreamingStore): broadcast objectWillChange for streaming subscribers
  • fix(GoalTaskPlugin): drop stale Sidebar response when switching conversations
  • fix(i18n): rename Promo Tasks rail header to 宣传图
  • fix(LLMKit): dedupe keychain status trace and fix APIKeyStore test fixtures
  • fix(LLMKit): serve in-memory cached API keys on flaky keychain reads
  • fix(PluginManager): notify UI immediately to avoid Toggle sticking
  • fix(PluginManager): refresh enable toggle via plugin change notification
  • fix(plugins): migrate tool activity to eventManager and disable MessageList verbose logging
  • fix(promo): guard empty storage paths and add booklet-maker-core en-US localization
